physical fight at school, one or more times during the past 12 months as of 2015?
questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer is 35% because, according to the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System data from 2015, this percentage accurately reflects the proportion of U.S. students aged 13-15 who reported being involved in physical fights at school within the previous year.
